rule: A hosted Thread id is x_ followed by one or more of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -. The id is opaque in length: a consumer checks the prefix and the characters and never a length. Vectors carry the id alone, without the thread: address type.

vectors.why: one character: no minimum length beyond it
not hex: every character class in the grammar
longer than any host mints today: a host's bound is not a consumer's check
a slash is not safe in a URL path
a space is not in the grammar
a dot is not in the grammar
a trailing newline is not part of the id
